# GQL ISO/IEC 39075:2024 — Bootstrap Conformance Baseline

*Auto-generated by `cargo xtask gql-coverage` (`cargo test -p cyrs-tck --features gql-iso --test gql_iso`).  Do not hand-edit.*

This file records the rolling parser-acceptance rate of the
`cyrs-db` front-end (in `DialectMode::GqlAligned`) against
the hand-authored GQL ISO bootstrap corpus under
`crates/cyrs-tck/tck/gql-iso-39075/` (see `README.md` for
scope and ISO §-citations).  Every Scenario Outline is
expanded against its `Examples:` table, so the counts below
are per-example, not per-outline.

"Accepted" means the parser emits zero syntax errors for the
query extracted from the scenario's `When executing query:`
step; it does **not** assert runtime semantics (the frontend
does no execution, spec §1.3 N1).

For grammar-production coverage (which of the 574 GQL.g4
parser productions a passing scenario reaches) see the sibling
`coverage.md`.
